name: How long does it take to install a permanent outdoor fire pit?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a permanent outdoor fire pit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a permanent outdoor fire pit typically ranges from a few days to several weeks, depending on the design, site preparation, and necessary utility connections. Simple installations involving a pre-fabricated unit and minimal site work can be quicker. However, custom-built fire pits requiring excavation, a new gas line, electrical wiring, or extensive masonry work will take longer. Permit acquisition time also influences the overall schedule. During the planning phase, Hometelligent Inc. will provide a projected timeline that accounts for all these variables, including any specific material lead times, to set clear expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a permanent outdoor fire pit varies from days to weeks, depending on design complexity, site preparation, and utility connections. Permit acquisition also affects the schedule.
